qualification: Eligible for fresh execution of the unchanged original pg-raw.P04 assertion under its original 60s deadline. This review is not that acceptance receipt; parent full gate is running separately.
resolvedFindings: Actual per-vector native Resource before images now feed both logical guards, and correspondence is rechecked immediately before the native command.
Post-write disclosed view comparisons now cover all 72 native vectors, including blind writes, NULL and int64 extremes.
Six malformed error-channel outcomes accepted by the initial classifier now refuse; generic primary/SQLSTATE/exit/empty stdout and success stderr are checked.
All nine ordinary identities have effective table/column/sequence and privileged role reachability comparisons; the UPDATE-only RETURNING control is nonvacuous.
Same-session masked and withheld guesses include NULL; missing-target, NULL-key, missing-enrollment, revoked-blind and unsupported-context phases retain full Staff/Resource/effects witnesses.
Native selected columns, PG18 NOT NULL constraint kinds, owner policy, no user triggers, owner flags, owners, FORCE RLS/barrier options and exact routine source are explicitly compared.

finalNative.intervalQualification: Observed log creation to receipt write, not an externally enforced timeout; governed gate enforces original 60s.

historicalIndependentNative.qualification: Exact earlier 790 runner, retained separately; final SQL/declarations/oracle unchanged, final runner adds controls.

sourceControls.scope: Closed authored source equality; not authenticated source issuance.

nativeWeakenings.scope: Actual SQL mutations executed using the isolated 790 runner plus a review-only failure-cleanup receipt hook. Final SQL/declarations/oracle and the per-vector checks detecting these mutations are unchanged. These were not rerun under the later 806 runner; exact snapshots and patches are retained.

formal.scope: Unbounded mathematical integer amounts and fixed Boolean current authority/read class. Abstract acknowledgment/refusal only; no TypeScript/SQL refinement, SQLNULL/isolation/lock/role/source authenticity, timing, diagnostics, missing-object, crypto or lifecycle proof.

binding.scope: Exact applied patch and case metadata comparison; receipt-tail framing uses retained component results only. No synthetic acceptance receipt retained.

limits: Fixed PostgreSQL 18.6 source-bound nullable int64 Resource.amount profile and selected subject-only literal/equality rules; not general policy-to-SQL compilation, catalog transform/provider support, graph/Delta support or whole-backend admission.

Logical changed-Field no-op semantics remain distinct from native explicit assignment intent. Native authorization precedes hidden lookup/equality and returns only acknowledgment; no exact no-op parity claim.

Trusted fresh excluded installer, source custody, namespace/role/DDL configuration and selected runtime files remain premises. No continuous authority/revocation, protected manifest, arbitrary DML/trigger, timing or complete deployment-route proof.
Finite NULL and NULL-key tests are distinct from the conditional mathematical-integer model; no embedded-NUL/general native string codec claim.
Native malformed diagnostics and effects checks cover the selected fixed routine and channels; no universal SQL error-channel or kernel refinement theorem.

Historical setup failures, initial classifier survivors and development receipts are retained; they are not final-source passes. Parent gate result and later documentation updates require their own exact receipts.
